body:

replies.author: Pelpelajax
replies.body:
Hello,

I have not been able to find any evidence that supports this ban. In addition, I respect the fact that you admit to hacking, and that you take responsibility for hacking. I am happy to appeal you, but if you're caught hacking again, you will remain banned when you try to appeal again.

Regards,
Pelp.

Translation

Hola. No he sido capaz de encontrar evidencia para soportar este ban. Ademas, respeto el hecho que admitas haber usado hacks, y que te presentes responsable de haber usado hacks. Te voy a apelar la infraccion, pero si te vemos usando hacks de nuevo, te quedaras baneado cuando vuelvas a intentar apelar. Saludos, Pelp
